dropped.1: BrowserSession gained three required methods (startUserTurn, commitUserTurn, clearUserTurn) and SessionActions with it, so a hand-written epoch-1 BrowserSession or SessionActions double no longer satisfies the type. aai-ui has no external implementers of either, and a consumer that only CALLS the session is unaffected.
dropped.2: BrowserSession is SEALED (a type-only browserSessionBrand only createBrowserSession mints), its three push-to-talk methods became the session.userTurn sub-handle (start/commit/clear), SessionActions is declared on its own without them, and usePushToTalk moved to the push-to-talk capability. An epoch-2 hand-written session double, or a caller of session.startUserTurn(), no longer compiles.
